title: SAP infrastructure transformation powered by AWS and Sify cloud@core
summary: Experience digital transformation powered by Cloud@Core. Read about how Sify's Cloud@Core platform helped a client achieve their digital transformation goals.
body_markdown:
#### A leading building-materials manufacturer modernizes its SAP environment through a secure, agile and fully managed hybrid cloud architecture.


#### Project Objective


Build an integrated, future-ready SAP and digital infrastructure on AWS.


#### Project Model


Fully managed services model replacing the existing capex-led infrastructure and services approach.


#### Sify's Uniqueness


Integrated solution combining AWS, Sify's cloud-adjacent data center, Hybrid Cloud Management Platform, cloud interconnect, security and migration services.


#### Integrated Value and Outcome


- SAP and cloud-ready applications migrated to AWS
- Greenfield SAP infrastructure provisioned on AWS
- Legacy workloads hosted in a cloud-adjacent data center
- Unified security implemented across hosted and AWS environments
- Active Directory integrated across private and cloud infrastructure
- Hybrid environments managed through a centralized platform


#### Value for client


Agile, digitally ready infrastructure, accelerated SAP modernization, integrated security and end-to-end ownership through a single transformation partner.
